body.x: SKONEC Entertainment, participated ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held at COEX in Samseong-dong from October 17th (Tue) to 20th (Fri) and introduced various VR contents.

SKONEC Entertainment, apart from various games, is the company that manufactures and publish VR contents needed in various fields, such as medical and architecture. The officials of the company said, “ We have focused to introduce more VR game in 2017 KES to the exhibitors” and added, “As there are various VR contents and platforms existing, we are exporting it the to overseas, and we plan to expand more from now on as well”.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
